services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: From the voracious and ever-eager black sea bass to “the bulldog at the bottom” (the tautog), and from the crazy-toothed triggerfish to the goofy-eyed flounder, these wrecks and reefs are swarming with fish. Knowing precisely where these wrecks are located (a closely guarded secret) and how to position the boat to fish them comes only with years of experience. Captain Dan of the Fin Chaser has been running boats off of Ocean City, Maryland for more than 35 years. While some slower boats are forced to stay closer to the inlet, the Fin Chaser’s speed allows our anglers to fish on wrecks that are much farther from the inlet and don’t get near the fishing pressure. The Fin Chaser is also

blurb: Guests spend a day fishing offshore for big game like marlin, tuna, mahi mahi, and shark, or nearshore for species like sea bass and flounder. The boat is rigged with over 35 rod/reel combos for various fishing styles including trolling, chunking, deep drop, and fly fishing. Captain Dan and crew provide a fun, comfortable, and safe fishing experience for all skill levels.
